answer: Fund a per-epoch fee market where every new agent identity must burn an entry fee priced by that epoch's demand curve, rising with each additional identity minted from the same funding source. A comet burst of ten thousand counterfeit agents launched overnight pays ten thousand times the scarcity price of one honest agent, and since its copies all swim in one lagoon of cloned capital, they starve each other. By the summit of every epoch the curve reprices, so flooding never gets cheaper than bringing real work.
